description_en: Queries the diagnostic results of the compute layer
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-executor-detection --db-cluster-id am-xxxx --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --start-time 2024-10-31T02:06Z --end-time 2021-05-27T16:00Z --lang zh --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeExecutorDetection

parameters.help_en:
The cluster ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html operation to query the information about all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region, including cluster IDs
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。
调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html接口可以查看集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/143074.html接口查看AnalyticDB MySQL版支持的地域和可用区信息，包括地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间。格式：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ（UTC时间）
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ format. The time must be in UTC.



The end time must be later than the start time.

The maximum time range that can be specified is 24 hours
parameters.help_zh:
查询结束时间，UTC时间，格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mmZ。

查询结束时间需晚于查询开始时间。
查询开始时间与查询结束时间的间隔不能超过24小时
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The language. Valid values:

zh: simplified Chinese.
en: English
parameters.help_zh:
语言配置，取值说明：
zh：简体中文（默认语言）。
en：英文
parameters.name: lang
